text:
You need a flexible US-based freelancer who can handle office support, research, appointments, data entry, and related Microsoft Office tasks reliably within a 25-hour weekly schedule.

I’m Mina Castellan, and I bring 5 years of experience in data analysis, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, SQL, data cleaning, and dashboard work. While my background is centered on data and reporting, that experience translates well to organized administrative support: keeping information accurate, maintaining clean records, structuring spreadsheets, preparing reports, and helping teams stay on top of recurring tasks.

One project that reflects how I work is the Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture. I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model using Power BI, DAX, SQL Server, and Excel to replace 14 separate Excel sales reports. That consolidation reduced monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. The result was a simpler, clearer process with less manual work and more dependable reporting.

For this role, I would focus on being responsive, detail-oriented, and dependable with the kinds of tasks that keep an office running smoothly. I’m comfortable working in Excel and Microsoft environments, handling data entry accurately, organizing information, supporting research, and helping create clean, easy-to-use materials when needed. I also value clear communication and steady follow-through, which are important for flexible support roles like this one.

If you’re looking for someone who can adapt quickly, work independently, and bring strong analytical discipline to administrative tasks, I’d be glad to help. I can support your team with the consistency and care needed to keep day-to-day work organized and moving forward.
